scope: Difficulty 0: 8 professions × 4 paired seeds = 64 runs; difficulty 3: 8 professions × 2 paired seeds = 32 runs; 96 full runs total.
method: Two-action greedy legal battle lookahead; paired deterministic seed strings beta19-${profession}-${index}-d${difficulty}; actual route rooms; rewards claimed using defaults; camp heal at HP <=24; shop once per act when affordable and not urgent for camp; evidence-supported acquisitions prefer nonduplicates. CandidateFit from rogue-build-system-v19.mjs (the heuristic retained by v20) is used consistently for v20 and v21. Pressure counts count distinct battle turns with enemyPressure >0 and distinct turns showing an intent with shieldAfter. Signature counters track hot_iron armor-pierce plays where forge reaches threshold, mail_return discounts applied to a recovered card, and medic_badge preparation from an active heal. Bellwatch delivery requires that the discounted UID is still in hand and has a discount at the next turn; gatebreak counts shield spent on plays. JSON roundtrip after every action; public wrapper used for actions and checked against direct v20/v21 dispatch.
limitations: Small deterministic policy sample, not human-play balance evidence. CandidateFit evidence is a heuristic; the policy does not optimize long-term deck value, relic/item purchases, shop services, event pacts, or route choices. Runs stop at a 600-action bound.
